security.sec_hero_description: Computer Vision + AI video analytics for detection, alerts, and incident workflows — designed for real security operations.
security.sec_included_description: Three pillars that work together to turn cameras into an operational intelligence system.
security.sec_phases_description: A structured three-phase approach from initial pilot through full-scale rollout.

sec_outcomes_accordion.title: Security improvement
sec_outcomes_accordion.checks:
Detect events consistently based on site rules and zones
Reduce time-to-response through alert workflows
Standardize incident handling across shifts

sec_outcomes_accordion.title: Asset protection & loss reduction
sec_outcomes_accordion.checks:
Improve coverage and consistency
Capture evidence snapshots automatically
Reduce missed incidents with prioritization

sec_outcomes_accordion.title: Operational improvement
sec_outcomes_accordion.checks:
Convert camera events into operational signals
Create multi-site visibility for management
Align detection and response to SOPs

sec_outcomes_accordion.title: Cost reduction
sec_outcomes_accordion.checks:
Reduce monitoring workload
Prioritize incidents so teams focus on what matters
Improve efficiency across sites with dashboards

sec_included_pillars.title: Analytics packs
sec_included_pillars.items:
Restricted area / zone monitoring
Anomaly detection (site-defined patterns)
Event triggers (rules-based)
Identity/track-based workflows (as permitted by requirements)

sec_included_pillars.title: Workflows and operations
sec_included_pillars.items:
Alert routing and escalation
Incident reporting and evidence capture
Dashboards and performance reporting
SOP alignment and operational playbooks

sec_included_pillars.title: Deployment readiness
sec_included_pillars.items:
Site assessment and camera mapping
Pilot design and success criteria
Rollout strategy across sites and camera groups
Governance (roles, access, retention practices)

sec_phases_items.title: Pilot & Validate

home.home_hero_heading: Your AI Solution Partner from roadmap to production deployment.
home.home_hero_description: We help organizations adopt practical AI that reduces cost, increases revenue, strengthens compliance, and improves security—through AI Solution Partnership, Computer Vision security, and humanoid robotics deployment.
home.home_hero_cta_subtext: Share your goal and constraints. Our team will reach out.
home.home_about_paragraphs:
AI-AI-AI Co., Ltd. helps organizations adopt AI in a practical, outcome-driven way. We operate as an AI Solution Partner (and AI development partner) — guiding you from strategy and use-case discovery through PoC, MVP, and full production deployment.
We also deliver specialized solutions in Computer Vision security / AI video analytics and humanoid robotics deployment (AgiBot with enhanced AI capability) — each designed for real operational adoption, not just proof of concept.
home.home_problems_description: Most organizations face at least one of these realities before they can scale AI.
home.home_problems_footer_text: Ai-Ai-Ai exists to turn AI ambition into deployed solutions that teams can operate and scale — from day one to full production.

home_problems_cards.title: Stuck at PoC
home_problems_cards.description: No one owns integration and rollout — AI pilots never reach production.

home_problems_cards.title: Too Many Use Cases
home_problems_cards.description: Teams can't prioritize without certainty on ROI or a clear starting point.

home_problems_cards.title: No Operational Control
home_problems_cards.description: Missing auditability, approval flows, and human-in-the-loop guardrails.

home_problems_cards.title: Security Gaps
home_problems_cards.description: Cameras alone aren't enough — teams need actionable intelligence and workflows.

home_problems_cards.title: Data Not Ready
home_problems_cards.description: Data exists but isn't structured, governed, or production-grade.

home_problems_cards.title: Physical Automation Risk
home_problems_cards.description: Deploying robots requires safety SOPs, maintenance plans, and escalation paths.

humanoid.hum_hero_description: Deployment-ready embodied & humanoid robotics with pilot planning, training, SOPs, integration, scalable planning, and rollout.

hum_robots.name: AGIBOT X2 ULTRA
hum_robots.title: AGIBOT X2 ULTRA
hum_robots.description: An intelligent humanoid robot with advanced capabilities in movement, interaction, and environmental awareness. Designed for versatile applications across multiple industries, it is suitable for offices, shopping malls, retail stores, exhibitions, or educational and scientific environments. The robot also supports various customization options to extend its capabilities for different use cases.
hum_robots.note: Recommended operation time: 7-8 minutes per session, with a rest period of 20 minutes.
hum_robots.specs:
Height / Weight / Arm Payload|131 cm / 37 kg / 3 kg
Battery|1 hour charging / up to 2 hours usage per cycle
Intelligent Perception|RGBD Camera + RGB Camera + Interaction Camera + LiDAR
Processing Unit|High-performance NVIDIA Orin NX 16GB
Interaction Capability|Supports interactive responses
Degrees of Freedom (DOF)|Full body: 31 / Arms: 7

hum_robots.name: AGIBOT D1 EDU
hum_robots.title: Embodied AI & Humanoid Robotic Solution
hum_robots.description: A compact, fast, and highly agile robot designed for dynamic environments. It features a self-learning motion system, allowing it to adapt to various terrains.
hum_robots.note: It is recommended to allow the robot to rest after extended operation (approximately 30 minutes).
hum_robots.specs:
Weight|15 kg
Maximum Payload|8 kg
Battery|1 hour charging / up to 2 hours usage
Step Climbing Ability|> 16 cm
Maximum Speed|3.7 m/s
Maximum Jump Height|35 cm

hum_robots.name: A2 ULTRA
hum_robots.title: A2 ULTRA
hum_robots.description: A large-scale humanoid robot designed for full commercial deployment in industrial environments. It meets international certification standards including CR, CE-MD, CE-RED, and FCC, and has already been deployed in more than 20 leading companies worldwide.
hum_robots.specs:
Height / Weight|169 cm / 69 kg
Walking Speed|0.8 m/s
Battery|1 hour charging / up to 3 hours usage per cycle
Perception System|LiDAR + Fisheye Camera + RGBD Camera + RGB Camera
Processing Unit|High-performance NVIDIA Jetson Orin
Intelligent System|Intelligent interaction with built-in skill package
Degrees of Freedom|40 (Arms: 7 / Legs: 6 / Hands: 6)

hum_robots.name: AGIBOT G2
hum_robots.title: Embodied AI & Humanoid Robotic Solution
hum_robots.description: Upgrade your operations with Agibot G2, an industrial-grade intelligent humanoid robot (Industrial-Grade Interactive Embodied Operation Robot). Designed with a fully modular structure and 100% humanoid form, it supports flexible component assembly and is powered by the intelligent Genie RL system for rapid deployment. It offers advanced communication capabilities, facial expression display, assisted operations, and natural human-like interaction.
hum_robots.specs:
Height / Weight|185 cm
Power System|Single charge usage over 2 hours
Performance|Each arm can handle up to 5 kg
Battery Life|Up to 4 hours (dual batteries, 1652 Wh)
Degrees of Freedom|Total 26 (7 per arm, 5 per leg, 4 waist, 3 head)
Processing Unit|NVIDIA Jetson T5000, AI up to 2070 TFLOPS
Sensor System|2x 3D LiDAR, 3x Fisheye, 3x RGB-D, 1x Stereo
Durability|Dust and water resistance IP42
